item.title: The plane that didn’t come back: survivorship bias in product decisions
item.description: Feedback from users who stayed, or from users who left? How survivorship bias skews product prioritization, plus five questions to make a better call.

item.title: Why is it so hard to quit food delivery (even when you swear you’ll cook more)?
item.description: Dopamine, habit loops, satisficing and hunger: what neuroscience says about why it’s so hard to stop ordering delivery, and what that teaches product designers.
